evidence.notes: Tracked source states that at 80%/50%/20% health Lokkestiiz flies into the air and ceases to be targetable while atronachs are summoned. During the flight he performs damaging lightning strafes and ends with a large ice/shock beam that must be blocked. This is boss-target downtime, not raid-action downtime.

evidence.source_locator: Skills and Abilities - Aerial Onslaught; Summon Frost Atronach; Summon Storm Atronach
evidence.notes: Aerial Onslaught states that a large number of atronachs are summoned during flight, while the same source page separately identifies Frost Atronach and Storm Atronach summons. The exact count is intentionally left unresolved.
